prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production sprite sheet for a cozy 2D isometric pixel-art village game, Cash Town. Generate exactly TWO isolated sprites on a truly transparent canvas in one horizontal row: LEFT is a closed wooden storage chest, RIGHT is exactly the same chest with the lid hinged fully open backwards. This is tier 1, the starter chest with 10 inventory slots. Plain honey-brown oak planks, two slim dark iron straps, a simple tiny brass front lock, short feet, gently arched lid. No decorations beyond basic hardware. The closed chest's apparent proportions should be width 51 by height 44 logical pixels; the open sprite width 54 by height 60, body and feet exactly matching the closed sprite. Draw the pair centered in equal halves of the canvas, plenty of fully transparent empty margin all around and between them, same ground baseline. View from three-quarter top down with front facing lower-left and the right side visible, conventional 2:1 isometric game art. Thick dark brown pixel outline, warm rich muted brown palette, chunky square pixels, simple flat shading in 3-4 shades per material, softly lit from upper left. Looks hand-pixelled at about 64px tall, enlarged with nearest-neighbor blocks, not high-resolution detailed art. Empty dark interior in the open chest, a subtle folded beige lining. Transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no characters, no extra objects. The chest must remain a friendly village storage box, not a treasure chest full of gold.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this two-sprite storage chest sheet. Create the 20-slot TIER 2 variant of the same game chest. Keep the exact two-sprite layout, left closed/right open, front facing lower-left with right side visible, matching body proportions between states, same pixel-art technique, warm palette, light from upper left and true transparent background. Upgrade BOTH chests to visibly roomier, slightly wider and taller oak chests, thick sturdy planks, THREE prominent dark forged-iron straps evenly spaced, strong dark iron corner brackets and a broader brass front lock plate. Add a small brass carrying handle on the visible right side. This is hardworking reinforced storage, not ornate treasure. It should feel one construction tier above the simple base chest but still cozy. Final sprite logical target approximately width 58px height 48px closed, 61px height 67px open. Keep lots of fully transparent margins, same ground line and no overlap. Empty dark interior with a subtle beige cloth liner. No text, no labels, no gold contents, no gems, no ground, no shadows, no extra objects. Preserve the original blocky pixelated style and dark outline, no smooth gradients or blur.

Interior empty and dark, simple beige linen liner. No text, no labels, no numbers, no ground, no shadows, no characters, no coins or loot. Keep crisp low-resolution pixel art, not a rendered realistic object.
